## Entities

### 1. `DownloadedModel` *(SDK type — read-only view)*

Source: `lmstudio.Client.list_downloaded_models()` → `lmstudio.sync_api.DownloadedModel`

| Attribute | Type | Usage |
|-----------|------|-------|
| `.model_key` | `str` | Unique model identifier (e.g. `qwen/qwen3-4b`). Used as callback data and display label. |
| `.info.display_name` | `str` | Human-friendly name; fallback for labels if available. |
| `.info.size_bytes` | `int` | Raw size in bytes. Formatted to `X.X GB` / `X MB` for display. |
| `.info.path` | `str` | Local file path (not displayed). |

**Display format**: `• {model_key}  {_format_size(info.size_bytes)}`  
**Load keyboard button label**: `[🟢 ]{model_key}  {_format_size(info.size_bytes)}` (truncated to 64 chars)  
**Callback data**: `models:loadmodel:{model_key}`

### 2. `LoadedModelHandle` *(SDK type — read-only view)*

Source: `lmstudio.Client.list_loaded_models()` → `lmstudio.sync_api.SyncModelHandle`

Resolved via `.get_info()` → `lmstudio._sdk_models.LlmInstanceInfo | EmbeddingModelInstanceInfo`

| Attribute | Type | Usage |
|-----------|------|-------|
| `.get_info().identifier` | `str` | The identifier under which the model was loaded (may differ from model_key if `--identifier` was used). Used as callback data and display label. |
| `.get_info().model_key` | `str` | Underlying model key — used for cross-referencing against downloaded model list (🟢 detection). |
| `.get_info().size_bytes` | `int` | Formatted same as DownloadedModel. |
| `.get_info().display_name` | `str` | Human-friendly name. |

**Display format**: `• {identifier}  {_format_size(info.size_bytes)}`  
**Unload keyboard button label**: `{identifier}  {_format_size(info.size_bytes)}` (truncated to 64 chars)  
**Callback data**: `models:unloadmodel:{identifier}`

### 3. `FormattedResponse` *(internal, not a class — a processed string)*

The result of `format_response(raw_text: str) -> str`. Not a distinct class; represented as `str` ready for `parse_mode="HTML"`.

#### Pipeline

```
raw_text (from LLM streaming, fully assembled)
  │
  ▼  strip_think_tags()
  │   re.sub(r'<think>.*?</think>', '', text, flags=re.DOTALL).strip()
  │   (removes all <think>…</think> blocks including content)
  │
  ▼  empty check
  │   if not text.strip() → return "*(no response)*"
  │
  ▼  convert_code_blocks()
  │   1. Find fenced blocks: ```[lang]\n…\n```
  │      - HTML-escape the code content
  │      - Wrap: <pre><code>…</code></pre>
  │   2. Find inline code: `…`
  │      - HTML-escape the code content
  │      - Wrap: <code>…</code>
  │
  ▼  escape_plain_text_segments()
  │   Escape <, >, & in all non-code segments using html.escape()
  │
  ▼  FormattedResponse (str, safe for parse_mode="HTML")
```

#### Validation rules

| Condition | Behaviour |
|-----------|-----------|
| Entire response is `<think>…</think>` | Returns `"*(no response)*"` |
| Multiple `<think>` blocks | All stripped |
| Unclosed `<think>` tag | Strip from `<think>` to end-of-string |
| Code block with language tag | Tag excluded from output |
| `<`, `>`, `&` inside code | HTML-escaped before wrapping |
| `<`, `>`, `&` in plain text | HTML-escaped |
| Telegram HTML entities outside code | Escaped (no accidental formatting) |

---

### 4. `_format_size(size_bytes: int) -> str` *(utility function)*

Converts raw bytes to human-readable string.

| Condition | Output |
|-----------|--------|
| `size_bytes >= 1_073_741_824` | `f"{size_bytes / 1_073_741_824:.1f} GB"` |
| Otherwise | `f"{size_bytes // 1_048_576} MB"` |

## State Transitions — Load Keyboard Interaction

```
User taps "⬆ Load Model"
  ↓
SDK: gather(list_downloaded_models, list_loaded_models)
  ↓ success: show inline keyboard (🟢 prefix for loaded)
  ↓ error: message "❌ Could not connect to LM Studio."

User taps a model button (callback: models:loadmodel:<key>)
  ↓
Edit keyboard message → "⏳ Loading <key>…"
  ↓
CLI: load_model(<key>)
  ↓ success: Edit message → "✅ Loaded <key>."
  ↓ error:   Edit message → "❌ Failed to load <key>: <reason>"
```

## State Transitions — Unload Keyboard Interaction

```
User taps "⬇ Unload Model"
  ↓
SDK: list_loaded_models()
  ↓ empty: message "No models are currently loaded."
  ↓ success: show inline keyboard (one button per loaded model)

User taps a model button (callback: models:unloadmodel:<id>)
  ↓
Edit keyboard message → "⏳ Unloading <id>…"
  ↓
CLI: unload_model(<id>)
  ↓ success: Edit message → "✅ Unloaded <id>."
  ↓ error:   Edit message → "❌ Failed to unload <id>: <reason>"
```
